purpose: Empirical HEBELTRADER featured-call selection criteria for a future Call-proposal module. Built from the operator Drive PDF corpus (gitignored locally). Not a trading recommendation.
policy: Stock identification and call selection remain separate stages.
Do not use featured WKNs as scan inputs for anonymous teasers.
Product terms at recommendation time come from the publisher PDF Stand Uhr.
Issuer preference is opportunistic liquidity/terms, not a single house bank.
Never commit PDF bytes or full extract text.

steps: Daily screening of a stock universe
Keep names with solid chart uptrend, supportive fundamentals, and stock-level CRV > 2
Then choose to trade the stock or a matching derivative
Derivative targets/stops derived from MA50/MA200 plus historical volatility

observed_product_template.labeled_tenor: median 5 months; common band 4–6 months (~74% of labeled cases)
observed_product_template.strike_style: moderately OTM Call (exact OTM% needs spot at Stand Uhr; PDF samples ~15–33%)

proposal_ranking_checklist: After stock ID is secured, search classic Calls only.
Prefer 4–6 months labeled remaining tenor (median publisher pick = 5).
Prefer Omega roughly 8–13 (median ~10); demote <7 or >15 unless CRV is exceptional.
Prefer strike moderately OTM vs Stand-Uhr spot.
Prefer conversion ratio 0.1 when available for the underlying.
Score by publisher-style CRV; target ≥ ~12 (median featured ~15).
Expect stop risk on the warrant around 60–70%.
Require tradeable spread/liquidity; issuer may be any major house (MS/JPM/SG/HSBC/UBS/Vontobel/…).
Exclude underlyings with an active featured call inside the 180-day lookback.
Independently verify ISIN/WKN, issuer terms, AT tradability, and risk before any suggestion.
limits: CRV/stop phrases are not extractable from every PDF layout (coverage CRV 69/134, stop 38/134).
Omega/months/strike coverage is high; OTM% needs paired spot at Stand Uhr for full distribution.
Issuer mapping uses WKN prefix heuristics validated against onvista samples.
